1_scope_and_owners.covers: the Harbor Lane Dental Facebook Page and Instagram account, every employee, and anyone posting for the practice

2_account_access: Two-step verification is on for both accounts and for every person with access.
Logins live in the practice's password manager. Nobody sends a login by text, email or chat.
The recovery email and phone belong to the practice, not to a person.
At least two admins on each account (the marketing manager and the practice administrator), assigned in Meta Business Suite. Nobody logs in as someone else.
A leaver loses access on their last day; the practice administrator checks it.

4_community_guidelines_public.text: Welcome to Harbor Lane Dental. This page is for news, tips and questions about our four clinics. To keep it useful and safe, we hide comments that share personal details (phone numbers, emails, insurance or health information), spam, scams and fake giveaways, and insults or attacks on anyone. Repeated or threatening posts lead to a ban. Complaints stay visible: we answer them here and then privately. We never confirm who is a patient in public. For anything about your care or your bill, call your clinic or message us, and we will help in private. Emergencies: call 911.

7_employee_guidelines: Your personal accounts are yours. When you post about dentistry or the practice, make clear the views are your own.
If you post about our services or share a clinic post with a comment, say that you work here.
Never post anything about a patient, even without a name: no photos in treatment rooms, no screens, no charts, no stories about a visit.
If you see a complaint about the practice, don't answer it yourself; send the link to the practice administrator.
Treat everyone with respect online, including people who criticise us.
Put no patient or practice information into AI tools that are not on the approved list.
Nothing in this policy limits your right to talk with coworkers or others about pay, hours or working conditions (NLRA Section 7). [legal review]
8_disclosure_rules: Creators who get a whitening kit or any other gift disclose it at the start of the post ("Gifted by Harbor Lane Dental" or "#ad"), not among the hashtags. In video they say it and show it.
Use the platform's paid partnership label as well; the label alone may not be enough.
Staff who praise the practice say they work here.
We never offer anything for a review that must be positive, never write reviews ourselves and never hide or remove negative reviews. [legal review]

health: Never confirm or deny that someone is a patient, even when they say so. Reply in general terms and invite a call. [legal review]
Patient photos, stories and before-and-after images need written authorization before posting. [legal review]
Health and result claims need evidence: no guaranteed results, and specialty or credential wording follows the state dental board's rules. [legal review]
Hide comments where people post their own health or insurance details, and reply without repeating them. [legal review]
Staff don't film or photograph where patients, screens or records can be seen. [legal review]

10_breaches_and_training: A first breach gets a conversation and a written note; repeated or serious breaches (any patient information) follow the staff handbook's disciplinary steps. [legal review]
New staff learn the policy in their first week; the marketing manager runs a 20-minute refresher every year.
Every employee signs that they have read it.
Review the policy, the keyword list and the reply targets every six months; next review 2027-04-28.
